none: PAS SWYOR-D731AE: Roman finger ring; TOT
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman silver finger ring dating from c. AD 100-300, inscribed with the letters "TOT" on the bezel. The hoop is rectangular in section, and becomes wider at the front to form a bezel. The bezel area is decorated with an incised rectangle ornamented with short transverse lines inscribed across the lines forming the rectangle.
